title: Ramsey Number $R(5,5)$
exact_target: What is the smallest number of vertices that forces a monochromatic complete graph on five vertices in every two-coloring?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1236 (COMB-013). CC BY 4.0.
Vigleik Angeltveit and Brendan D. McKay, \emph{$R(5,5)\leq46$}, arXiv:2409.15709v2 (2025), Section 1.
